newsitem.title: USA: U-haul parent Amerco buys back shares in settlement.
newsitem.headline: U-haul parent Amerco buys back shares in settlement.

text.p: Amerco Inc, the holding company for U-Haul International Inc., said Sunday it bought 4.04 million of its shares from Katabasis International Inc. as part of a settlement agreement involving the son of the founder of the truck rental firm.
The company said it paid Katabasis about $27.5 million for the stock and paid Samuel Shoen about $75 million in connection with the purchase.
Shoen is Katabasis' sole voting stockholder and the son of U-Haul founder L.S. Shoen, Amerco said in a statement released over the weekend.
The stock purchase and other payments were made as a result of a settlement of various disputes between the Shoen family and Amerco's board, the company said.
The remaining settlement amount of about $153 million will be paid on or before Oct. 1, and an additional 6.05 million shares will be bought at that time, Amerco said.
